description: This file defines the 'Defect' entity class for a defect tracking system, annotated for use with JPA/Hibernate ORM. It includes fields such as id, title, description, severity, status, location, createdBy, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Defect
classes.description: Entity class representing a defect report with attributes like title, description, severity, status, etc., using JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the defect.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Gets the title of the defect.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the defect.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the defect.

methods.name: getSeverity
methods.description: Returns the severity level of the defect.

methods.name: setSeverity
methods.description: Sets the severity level of the defect.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the defect.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the defect.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the location associated with the defect.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location related to the defect.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the creator of the defect record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Assigns the creator of the defect record.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the defect was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the defect was last updated.
